# SatLong 〔BlitzLLVM〕

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Math](BlitzBasic-Math)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
SatLong:Int32 value:Float32
```

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Float32 | required | A number or a text with a number in it. |

**Returns:** The number, or the closest number of the type if it does not fit.

## Description

**〔BlitzLLVM〕** This command does not exist in the original Blitz products. BlitzLLVM adds it.

<!-- AUTOGENERATED COPYRIGHT HEADER START -->
Converts a number or a text to a Long (-9223372036854775808 to 9223372036854775807) and stops at -9223372036854775808 and 9223372036854775807 instead of wrapping around. This is a BlitzLLVM extension: the originals have no integers of other sizes. A whole number outside the range becomes the closest number of the range, and a real is rounded to the nearest whole number (halves go to the even one) first. A real that is not a number becomes 0. [Long](Long) does the same for a real, but wraps whole numbers around.

## Differences

* Not in the originals, which have no integers of other sizes.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Print SatLong(ULong(-1))
Print SatLong(ULong(7))
```

```text
9223372036854775807
7
```
